steps.content: The journey into the depths is surprisingly smooth. Though the area is severely damaged, it's obvious that someone had cleared the obstacles ahead.

Most importantly, there aren't many enemies. Even when the Nirvana robots try to attack you occasionally, the Rustfire combatants would destroy them faster than a whack-a-mole game. They really are well-prepared for this trip.
Those <color=#fb9259>apparitions</color> also appear from time to time, and you can now make out some of their voices.

steps.speaker: Vague Phantom
steps.content: Score! The handover was a success! This mine is ours from now on! We don't have to worry about Hypercubes anymore!

steps.speaker: Vague Phantom
steps.content: Wait until we finish transferring everything before you celebrate. With so many machines, who knows how long it'll take? I'm hungry. Any burritos left? I only want the ones **** made...

steps.speaker: Vague Phantom
steps.content: Get the <color=#fb9259>little architect</color> to come. He's smarter than you... He'd be furious if he knew you snuck into the mine without telling him.

steps.speaker: Vague Phantom
steps.content: No thanks. You know how slow he is. If there was a contamination leak, he'd be a goner.

steps.speaker: Vague Phantom
steps.content: Ha! He'd probably say, "With **** around, what's there to be scared off? Even if the sky falls, **** will catch it..." He's a leader, after all!

steps.speaker: Vague Phantom
steps.content: This one is activated. On to the next one... Come with me!
Laughing and throwing their arms over each other's shoulders, the apparitions pass through you and vanish into the distance. In front of you, another group of apparitions appears.
To your surprise, you feel no fear traversing amidst these shadowy apparitions. Instead, you feel like they're odd friends who had time-traveled to keep you company.
Their hope and trust for each other makes your journey into the abyss a bit less lonely and depressing.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Those are the workers from before?

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: Yes. The heroes of that era.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: After the DisSea Explosion, Hypercube production collapsed. The remaining reserves simply could not meet the demand. DisCity was really on the brink of implosion.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: These workers were the ones who risked their lives to go into the mine.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: They worked during the day, and guarded the mine from gangsters at night. After a while, they organized their own militia—Rustfire.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: <size=29>Scores of people probably got infected with Mania, but there weren't many reports of them turning into Corruptors. The BR-000 had just appeared, so there wasn't much knowledge about Mania yet. But I imagine quite a few of those infected in Inner Bay became Sinners.</size>

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: These were people who mined at the foot of DisSea's Black Ring. They refused to bow their heads even in the face of the great explosion. They had the skills, and they had perseverance. Weren't they cool?

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: They were the ones who gave it their all to keep up Hypercube production and replenish the reserves. They were the ones who helped DisCity pull through its most difficult period.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Quit bragging, you lying bird. How come I've never met such noble Syndicans before?

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: They're all here. The last witnesses of the golden age, the Inner Bay heroes who fought with hope...

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: I've been wanting to meet you for a long time.
Raven reaches out to an apparition, as if wanting to caress its face. Yet the apparition simply goes through her.
But Raven isn't upset. She grins, swings her outstretched hand the other way and slaps you on the back, making you stumble.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: It's your turn now!

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: Back then, the Inner Bay workers created this magnificent project. Today, their successors can surely take it back. I'm even more sure of it because of your help.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: How is it down there? You must know best, right?

The Corpuscle isn't here. It's different from encountering inheritance. Here, you can feel the presence of a huge Mania body, but it doesn't have that terrible <color=#fb9259>core</color>. So at least there's no risk of a Black Ring explosion.
However...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: <size=29>Perhaps due to the Ringmaster's power, the two half-bodies, one dead and one alive, are still somehow deeply connected. The living half is out there spreading Mania and devouring people's spiritual energy. The resulting contamination is transferred to the dead half.</size>
It's only been a few days since the tragedy in the Drifter Camp. Where did the spiritual contamination from all those victims go?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Huh? Are we at the bottom of the pit?
Before you is a small pool of water that submerges the path ahead.
Is it <color=#fb9259>water</color> from DisSea that had flowed down from above?
No... upon closer inspection, the water level is slowly rising. The squirming liquid gives you a sense of deja vu.

The liquid is welling up from underneath. It's contamination from the living half of the Corpus! That half is still active and creating Mania, and its contamination has completely blocked the path ahead.
At the same time, you see apparitions rising up from the shallow pool.

steps.speaker: Phantom Shadow
steps.content: Go... activate the next one... must complete... the handover...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: They came from here?
The apparitions rise from the pool and walk ashore, heading towards you. Their bodies become clearer and clearer.

steps.speaker: Phantom Shadow
steps.content: That was just an accident... Hold on... I know these machines, I'll go... destroy them...

steps.speaker: Phantom Shadow
steps.content: I'll take care of the injured... You guys continue... Hurry...

steps.speaker: Phantom Shadow
steps.content: It's not a problem... It's not a problem... We're almost... almost done...

steps.speaker: Phantom Shadow
steps.content: There's still hope... Hang on...

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: ...They look so strange. Is it the contamination?
Was that the reason?
You reach towards an apparition heading towards you. Is this something that physically exists, or...
Your shackles quietly penetrate the apparition, whose face suddenly warps and becomes incomparably murky. Even its voice becomes blurry.

steps.speaker: Phantom Shadow
steps.content: There's still... hope...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: These aren't just concretized contaminants. The reason we can see these apparitions is that our minds have already been infected by Mania from the mine.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Leave now!
Your nervous shouts seem to have attracted the apparitions around you. They turn around and move towards you with their hands outstretched.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Chief!

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: Wait, don't provoke them!

Too late. Hecate's Nightmare is already roaring and lunging at the apparition closest to you. The attack makes the apparitions warp at the same time. You see emotion on Hecate's face again, but this time, it's sheer terror.
